name: Indie Hackers

sources.title: Products page — Products Database with 'Add Your Product' and 'Submit an Update' (Build Board)

requirements: Free Indie Hackers account (Sign up / Sign in required; full directory access itself is gated behind a free account)
Products are listed with self-reported monthly revenue — be prepared to state a revenue figure publicly
preparation: Product name, URL, description, category (one of ~80 listed categories) and business model (Free, Advertising, Affiliate/Commission, Transactional, Subscription-Based)
Self-reported monthly revenue figure — displayed publicly on the listing (e.g. '$0/month self-reported revenue')
Optional: updates/posts for the Build Board Beta voting surface
workflow: Go to /products and click 'Add Your Product' (/products/new or /products/submit)
Fill in product profile including category, business model, and revenue
Publish; the product then appears in the Products Database filters and your profile
watchFor: Revenue is self-reported and public — list a figure you are comfortable displaying
The Products Database is a long-lived profile, not a launch event; the 'Build Board Beta' is a separate daily voting surface with 'Submit an Update'
Browsing the full directory requires a free account — low-friction but account-walled
IH+ subscription is an upsell for content/community features, not required to list
countsAsLive: Product page at /product/<slug> exists and appears in the Products Database under its category/business-model filters
unknowns: Whether new products go through any manual approval
Build Board submission mechanics (eligibility, cadence) beyond the visible 'Submit an Update' link
Whether revenue figures can be kept private while still listing
